			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_rural_systematic_opposition
		}
		### Specific

		# Buddhist Monks (Japan)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_has_state_religion = rel:mahayana
				country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
			}
			ig:ig_devout = {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_buddhist_monks
				bpm_ig_make_buddhist_moralist = yes
			}
		}
		# Shinto Monks (Japan)

			limit = {
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_state_atheism }
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "STATE_ATHEISM_LAW"
				value = 0.1
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "RELIGIOUS_INSTITUTIONS"
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						OR = {
							has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
							has_law = law_type:law_charitable_health_system
						}
					}
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "DEVOUT_LITERACY"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					NOT = { 
						is_pop_type = clergymen
					}
				}
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = -100
				add = 50
				max = 0
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "THEOCRACY"
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { has_law = law_type:law_theocracy }

		multiply = {
			desc = "RELIGION_SUPPRESSED"

			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen

					}
				}
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
	}
	monarch_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_devout = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}
	agitator_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_devout = {

		}

		# ideology_republican_leader

		ideology_reformer
		ideology_sovereignist_leader
		# ideology_authoritarian
		# ideology_orleanist
		# ideology_humanitarian
		# ideology_land_reformer
	}

always = yes
	}
	on_enable = {
ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_well_oiled_machine
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_urban_systematic_opposition

				limit = {
					owner = {

							c:BIC ?= this
							any_primary_culture = {
								has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
							}
						}
					}
				}
				bpm_remove_all_eco_ideologies = yes
				add_ideology = ideology_eco_modernizer
				bpm_reorder_ideologies = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_disable = {

	}
	priority_cultures = {
#Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:ZAN ?= this
				any_primary_culture = {
					cu:bedouin = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				swahili bedouin
			}
		}
	}
	on_character_ig_membership = {
if = {
			limit = { is_historical = no }
			if = {
				limit = { 
					modifier:interest_group_bpm_intelligentsia_force_leader_non_moderate = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
				set_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
			}
		}
	}

custom_tooltip = {
			text = BPM_VALID_POP_FOR_IG
			owner ?= {
				NOT = {
					is_country_type = decentralized
				}
			}
		}
	}
	pop_weight = {
value = 0
	
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = shopkeepers }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				value = 200
			}
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_mercantilism } }
				add = {
					desc = "MERCHANT_GUILDS"
					value = 100
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				value = 200
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = bureaucrats }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = engineers }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ENGINEERS"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = machinists }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 
				owner = { 
					active_law:lawgroup_economic_system = {
						has_amendment = amendment_type:bpm_amendment_artisanal_economy
					}

			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POP_ARTISANS"
					value = 350
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POP_ARTISANS"
					value = 50
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						strata = upper
						is_pop_type = academics
						is_pop_type = bureaucrats
						is_pop_type = clergymen
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POP_ARTISANS"
					value = 350
					workplace ?= {multiply = self_ownership_fraction}
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "NONPRIMARY_CULTURE"

			if = {
				limit = {
					pop_has_primary_culture = no
					strata = middle
					bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = no
				}
				value = 150
			}
		}	
		add = {
			desc = "POLITICAL_MACHINES"
			if = {
				limit = {
					strata = middle
					owner = {
						OR = {
							has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
							has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
							has_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
						}
					}
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BIC ?= owner
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_INDIA_COLONIAL_RULE"
				value = 0.001 #0.1
			}
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:BIC ?= owner
				culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = capitalists
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_INDIA_MONEYED_ELITES"
				value = 50 #75
			}
		}

		multiply = ig_attraction_to_interests_from_stability
	}
	monarch_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}
	agitator_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			value = bpm_base_agitator_weight
		}
	}
	commander_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_intelligentsia = {
			value = bpm_commander_weight
		}
	}

value = 0.1
	}

value = 0.1
	}
	female_commander_chance = {

	ideologies = {
ideology_sta_decentralized_state
		ideology_mil_aristocratic_militarist

		}
		# Squattocracy
		if = {
			limit = {

				set_interest_group_name = ig_squattocracy
			}
		}

					}

		}
	}
	pop_potential = {
custom_tooltip = {

			owner ?= {

					is_country_type = decentralized
				}
			}
		}
	}
	pop_weight = {
value = 0
	
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clerks }

			}
		}
		else_if = {

				value = 250
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = capitalists }

		else_if = {

				value = 20
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS_CON"
				value = 250
			}
		}			
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = aristocrats }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
				value = 50
			}
		}
				
		add = {
			desc = "MILD_DISCRIMINATION"
			if = {
				limit = {
					pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_3
					pop_acceptance <= acceptance_status_4
					bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = no
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_appointed_bureaucrats
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POLITICAL_MACHINES"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
						has_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POLITICAL_MACHINES"
				value = 50
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {

				}

value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_character_spawn_chance

	commander_leader_chance = {
value = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = {

				min = 0

REPLACE:ig_agrarian_populists = {
	color = hsv{ 0.32 0.67 0.75 }
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/ig_icons/agrarian_populists.dds"
	layer = "revolution_dynamic_rural_folk"
	index = 8
	ideologies = {
ideology_nonexistent
	}
	character_ideologies = {
ideology_center_leader
		ideology_pacifist
		ideology_protectionist
		ideology_radical
		ideology_liberal_leader
		ideology_reformer
		ideology_nihilist
		ideology_humanitarian
	}
	enable = {
always = yes
	}
	on_enable = {
#bpm_add_movement_interaction = { int = agpop_split }
		ig:ig_agrarian_populists ?= {
			# #set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_bastion_of_freedom
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_opposition
		}
	}
	on_disable = {

	}
	priority_cultures = {
#Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}

		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:CHI ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:manchu = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				han
			}
		}
	}
	on_character_ig_membership = {

	}
	pop_potential = {
custom_tooltip = {
			text = BPM_VALID_POP_FOR_IG
			owner = {
				ig:ig_agrarian_populists ?= {
					bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nonexistent }
				}
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = capitalists
			is_pop_type = bureaucrats
		}
	}
	pop_weight = {
value = 20	

		##### RURAL POP WEIGHTS ONLY #####
		if = {
			limit = { 
				bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = yes
			}
			add = {
				desc = "RURAL_POP"
				value = 50
			}
			# Free farmers are more likely to be agpops
			if = {
				limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
				add = {
					desc = "POP_FARMERS"
					value = 100
				}
			}
			# Free peasants are less likely to be agpops
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
					NOT = { owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom } }
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POP_FREE_PEASANTS"
					value = -40
				}
			}
			# Unfree labor makes more agpops
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_pop_type = farmers }
					owner = {
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned }
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POP_RURAL_ABOLITIONISTS"
					value = 80
				}
			}
			# Literacy adds to agpops
			if = {
				limit = { strata < upper }
				add = {
					desc = "POP_EDUCATED_FARMERS"
					value = literacy_rate
					multiply = 250
					max = 200
				}
			}
			# Agsocs
			if = {
				limit = {
					strata < upper
					scope:interest_group = { has_variable = bpm_ig_is_socialist_var }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture } }
					add = {
						desc = "POP_RURAL_ANTICAPITALISM"
						value = 100
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner = { NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture } }
						}
						add = {
							desc = "POP_RURAL_WANTS_COLLECTIVIZATION"
							value = 60
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							owner = { has_law = law_type:law_collectivized_agriculture }
							pop_radical_fraction <= 0.05
						}
						add = {
							desc = "POP_RURAL_HAPPY_UNDER_SOCIALISM"
							value = 150
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		
		##### IF NOT RURAL POP AND NOT ACADEMIC, EXCLUDE #####
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_pop_type = academics }  }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EXCLUSIONS"
				value = -100
			}	
		}

		##### ACADEMICS ARE LEADERS #####
		add = {
			desc = "POP_LEADERS"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					is_pop_type = academics
					owner = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom }
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}

		##### PEASANT/FARMER ANGER SYMPATHY SUPPORT #####
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_ig_farmers_angry_var } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_pop_type = soldiers }
				add = {
					desc = "POPS_ANGER_SYMPATHY"
					value = 60
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_pop_type = clergymen
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POPS_ANGER_SYMPATHY"
					value = 150
				}
			}
		}

		##### EXPENSIVE CALCS #####
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { bpm_performance_significant_country = yes } }
			
			add = ig_attraction_agrarian_socialism

			multiply = {
				desc = "LEADER_POPULARITY"
				scope:interest_group = {
					leader = {
						value = popularity
						multiply = 0.005
						add = 1
						max = 1.5
						min = 0.67
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = bpm_ig_agitators_popularity
			multiply = bpm_ig_ruler_popularity
			multiply = { desc = bpm_ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists_tt value = ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists }
		}
		multiply = ig_attraction_to_ruler_ideology_from_stability
	}
	monarch_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_agrarian_populists = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}
	agitator_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_agrarian_populists = {
			value = bpm_base_agitator_weight
		}
	}
	commander_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_agrarian_populists = {
			value = bpm_commander_weight
		}
	}
	executive_weight = {
value = 0.1
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.ig:ig_agrarian_populists = { bpm_interest_group_is_activated = no }
			}
			value = 0.0
		}
	}
	noble_chance = {
value = 0.2
	}
	female_commander_chance = {
value = 1.0
		multiply = bpm_female_commander_spawn_chance
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_protected_class
				}
			}

if = {

	}

		ideology_nihilist

#has_variable = local_anarchists_split_var
		always = yes
	}
	on_enable = {
#set_variable = local_anarchists_split_var
		ig:ig_anarchists ?= {
			# #set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_bastion_of_freedom
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_opposition
		}

		#create_anarchist_start_characters = yes
	}
	on_disable = {

	}
	priority_cultures = {
#Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}

					cu:manchu = this

				han

custom_tooltip = {

					bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes 
				}
			}
		}

			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = capitalists
		}
	}
	pop_weight = {
value = 5

			limit = { 
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
					is_pop_type = clerks
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_PROLETARIAT"
				value = 50
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EDUCATED_PROLETARIAT"
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = 80
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EDUCATED_FARMERS"
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = 100
			}
		}
		# else_if = {
		# 	limit = {
		# 		is_pop_type = peasants
		# 	}
		# 	add = {
		# 		desc = "POP_EDUCATED_PEASANTS"

		# 		multiply = 20
		# 	}
		# }
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = academics
					is_pop_type = engineers
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_LEADERS"
				value = 40
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

			add = {
				desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				value = 70
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { 
				bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = no
			}
			add = {
				desc = "URBAN_POP"
				value = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_employed = no }
				add = {
					desc = "URBAN_UNEMPLOYED"
					value = 50
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "POPS_ANGER_SYMPATHY"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					OR = {
						is_pop_type = farmers
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_ig_laborers_angry_var }
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}


		add = {
			desc = "POP_DISCRIMINATED"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					pop_acceptance <= acceptance_status_3
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}	
		
		add = ig_attraction_agrarian_socialism

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { bpm_performance_significant_country = yes } }
			add = ig_attraction_tmp_bpm_non_rural_socialist
			add = {
				desc = "POWERFUL_FAC"
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_country_has_powerful_fascists_var } }
					value = 30
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "LEADER_POPULARITY"
				scope:interest_group = {
					leader = {
						value = popularity
						multiply = 0.01
						add = 1
						max = 2.0
						min = 0.5
					}
				}
			}	
			multiply = bpm_ig_agitators_popularity
			multiply = bpm_ig_ruler_popularity

		}

			}		
		}

					}

REPLACE:ig_fascists = {
	color = hsv{ 0.10 1 0.5 }

	index = 11
	ideologies = {
ideology_nonexistent
	}
	character_ideologies = {
ideology_center_leader
		ideology_authoritarian
		ideology_theocrat

		ideology_ethno_nationalist
		ideology_nihilist

always = yes
	}

			# #set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_right_systematic_corruption

			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_right_systematic_opposition
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					c:CLM ?= this
				}		
			}
			ig:ig_fascists ?= {
				set_interest_group_name = ig_integralists
			}
		}
	}
	on_disable = {

	}

	}

custom_tooltip = {
			text = BPM_VALID_POP_FOR_IG
			owner ?= {
				NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
				exists = ig:ig_fascists

		pop_acceptance >= acceptance_status_4

value = 0

					strata = middle

				value = 75

			if = {

			}

				desc = "LOST_WAR"

				}
			}
			multiply = bpm_ig_agitators_popularity
			multiply = bpm_ig_ruler_popularity
			multiply = {
				desc = "POLITICAL_AGITATION"	
				value = 1.0

					}

				}		
			}	
			multiply = { desc = bpm_ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists_tt value = ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists }
		}

			desc = "LEADER_POPULARITY"
			scope:interest_group = {
				leader = {
					value = popularity
					multiply = 0.01 # Fascists are heavily dependent on their leader

					max = 2
					min = 0.1
				}
			}
		}

					}

	pop_weight = {
value = 30

			limit = {
				owner = {

		else_if = {

		}

				desc = "RURAL"
				value = 50
			}
		}
		if = {

ideology_nonexistent
	}
	character_ideologies = {

		ideology_republican_leader

		ideology_vanguardist
		ideology_nihilist

always = yes
	}
	on_enable = {
#bpm_add_movement_interaction = { int = revsoc_split }
		ig:ig_revolutionist_socialists ?= {
			# #set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_corruption
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_bastion_of_freedom
			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_opposition
		}
	}
	on_disable = {

	}
	priority_cultures = {
#Country scope
		rule = {
			trigger = {
				c:BIC ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:british = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				assamese avadhi baluchi bengali bihari gujarati kannada malayalam marathi oriya panjabi pathan rajput sindi tamil telegu hindustani bundeli pahari gondi bageli chhattisgarhi deccani
			}
		}

			trigger = {
				c:CHI ?= this
				any_primary_culture = { 
					cu:manchu = this
				}
			}
			cultures = {
				han
			}
		}
	}

	}
	pop_potential = {
custom_tooltip = {
			text = BPM_VALID_POP_FOR_IG
			owner ?= {
				ig:ig_revolutionist_socialists ?= {
					NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nonexistent }
					bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
				}
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = capitalists
		}
	}
	pop_weight = {
value = 20

			limit = { 
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
					is_pop_type = laborers
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_PROLETARIAT"
				value = 50
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EDUCATED_PROLETARIAT"
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = peasants
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EXCLUSIONS"
				value = -50
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			add = {
				desc = "POP_EDUCATED_FARMERS"
				value = literacy_rate
				multiply = 100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = academics
					is_pop_type = engineers
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_LEADERS"
				value = 60
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { 
				is_pop_type = soldiers
				owner = { has_variable = bpm_ig_laborers_angry_var }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				value = 100
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { 
				bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = no
			}
			add = {
				desc = "URBAN_POP"
				value = 30
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_employed = no }
				add = {
					desc = "URBAN_UNEMPLOYED"
					value = 70
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "POPS_ANGER_SYMPATHY"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					OR = {
						is_pop_type = farmers
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_ig_laborers_angry_var }
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "POP_DISCRIMINATED"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					pop_acceptance <= acceptance_status_3
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}	

		add = ig_attraction_agrarian_socialism

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { bpm_performance_significant_country = yes } }
			multiply = 0.125
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_strong_labor 
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "BPM_STRONG_LABOR"
					value = 20
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_average_labor 
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "BPM_AVERAGE_LABOR"
					value = 4
				}
			}

			add = {
				desc = "POWERFUL_FAC"
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_country_has_powerful_fascists_var } }

				}
			}
			add = ig_attraction_tmp_bpm_non_rural_socialist

				desc = "LEADER_POPULARITY"

						value = popularity

			multiply = bpm_ig_ruler_popularity
			multiply = {

				value = 1.0
				if = {

					value = 1.3
				}		
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "DEVASTATED"	
				value = 1.0
	
				if = {
					limit = { 
						state = {
							devastation > 5
						}
					}
					value = 1.5
				}		
			}	
			multiply = { desc = bpm_ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists_tt value = ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists }
		}

		multiply = ig_attraction_to_ruler_ideology_from_stability

		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_country_very_undemocratic_var } }
			multiply = {
				desc = "NO_DEMOCRACY"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}

				limit = { is_employed = no }
				add = {
					desc = "URBAN_UNEMPLOYED"
					value = 100
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "POPS_ANGER_SYMPATHY"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					OR = {
						is_pop_type = farmers
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
					owner = { has_variable = bpm_ig_laborers_angry_var }
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "POP_DISCRIMINATED"
			if = {
				limit = { 
					pop_acceptance <= acceptance_status_3
				}
				value = 50
			}
		}	
		
		add = ig_attraction_agrarian_socialism

		if = {
			limit = {
				total_size > 1000
				owner = { bpm_performance_significant_country = yes }
			}
			multiply = 0.125
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_strong_labor 
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "BPM_STRONG_LABOR"
					value = 6
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_average_labor 
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "BPM_AVERAGE_LABOR"
					value = 4
				}
			}

			add = ig_attraction_tmp_bpm_non_rural_socialist
			multiply = {
				desc = "LEADER_POPULARITY"
				scope:interest_group = {
					leader = {
						value = popularity
						multiply = 0.01
						add = 1
						max = 2.0
						min = 0.5
					}
				}
			}	
			multiply = bpm_ig_agitators_popularity
			multiply = bpm_ig_ruler_popularity
			multiply = {
				desc = "DEVASTATED"	
				value = 1.0
	
				if = {
					limit = { 
						state = {
							devastation > 5
						}
					}
					value = 1.5
				}		
			}
			multiply = { desc = bpm_ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists_tt value = ig_attraction_from_radicals_and_loyalists }
		}

		multiply = ig_attraction_to_ruler_ideology_from_stability

		owner = {
			multiply = {
				desc = "WEAK_UNIONS"
				value = 1.0

				if = {
					limit = { 
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_country_has_established_unions_history_var }
					}
					value = 0.5
				}		
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "ESTABLISHED_UNIONS"	
				value = 1.0

				if = {
					limit = { 
						has_variable = bpm_country_has_powerful_unions_var
					}
					value = 1.5
				}		
			}

			multiply = {
				desc = "AT_WAR"	
				value = 1.0

				if = {
					limit = { is_at_war = yes }
					value = 1.9
				}		
			}	

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_technology_researched = labor_movement } }
				multiply = {
					desc = "NO_LABOR_MOVEMENT"
					value = 0.5
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_technology_researched = socialism } }
				multiply = {
					desc = "NO_SOCIALISM"
					value = 0.7
				}
			}

			multiply = {
				desc = "SPLIT_SOCIALISTS"
				value = 1.0

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = local_revsocs_split_var
					}
					value = 0.5
				}			
			}
		}
	}
	monarch_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_socialists = {
			value = bpm_ig_monarch_weight
		}
	}
	agitator_weight = {
owner.ig:ig_socialists = {
			value = bpm_base_agitator_weight
		}
	}

value = 0.0

value = 0.0
	}

	layer = "revolution_dynamic_trade_unions"
	index = 7

	}

always = yes
	}

			#set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_left_systematic_opposition
		}

		# Put IG initialization here (in an arbitrary IG), so it happens before any on actions (hopefully)
		# This is a bit of a hack, but it's the only way to do it
		if = {
			limit = { game_date > 1836.1.1 }
			owner = {
				bpm_setup_country_sta_ideologies = yes
				bpm_setup_country_rel_ideologies = yes

		}
	}
	on_disable = {

	}
